prompts.vhs: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: reusable open VHS product illustration for Cinefita, a warm dark film archive website. Create a premium photorealistic studio product render of ONE unbranded black VHS cassette, outside its open black plastic clamshell case. Direct overhead camera, absolutely no perspective skew. Landscape composition with transparent background, all items fully visible. Open case spreads horizontally from x=12% to x=88%, y=14% to y=86%. Left lid has a perfectly flat blank warm-gray rectangular paper sleeve area, exactly x=15% to x=45%, y=20% to y=80%, reserved for a movie cover to be inserted by the website. Right lid at x=52%-85% holds a realistic black VHS cassette with two transparent reel windows, small blank pale label, tactile molded details. Case hinge centered at x=49%. Subtle amber studio edge lighting, sophisticated material detail and realistic contact shadow, sharply photographed, isolated transparent alpha. No movie artwork, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no extra discs or collector extras. The left rectangular area must remain completely empty. This is one generic packaging mockup, not an official retail edition.
